selection.rule: Print-adjacent leftovers after next-72. No overlap with the 72. Skip animation, speech, scroll, pointer, 3D, and vendor aliases whose bases are print-noop. Include a Borders-4-style honesty-defer batch for mask-border, MathML, filter primitives, and path-length.

properties.syntax: initial | inherit | unset | revert | revert-layer | revert-rule
properties.description: With `all: unset` inherited color and font on this box should snap back to initial values.
properties.notes: Honesty demote 2026-08-28: no all apply arm; column-span:all is a different value. Subset initial|inherit|unset. Skip revert/revert-layer until UA restore exists.

properties.description: With `-webkit-background-clip: padding-box` the background fill should clip to the padding box.
properties.notes: Phase 82 slice B. Base background-clip is Implemented. Add normalizeVendorPrefix case + TestWebkitPrefixAliases. Demo padding-box/content-box only; text clip is not painted.

properties.description: With `-webkit-background-origin: content-box` the background image should start from the content box.
properties.notes: Phase 82 slice B. Base background-origin is Implemented.

properties.description: With `-webkit-background-size: cover` the background image should cover the origin box.
properties.notes: Phase 82 slice B. Base background-size is Implemented.

properties.description: With `-webkit-line-clamp: 2` overflow text should keep two lines.
properties.notes: Apply + LineClamp consumer already exist (style_advanced_props.go, inline.go). Catalog note about no print consumer is stale. Flip after a prefixed TestWebkitPrefixAliases case.

properties.description: With `word-space-transform: space` word-separator spacing should follow the chosen transform. Chrome does not support this property (no MDN BCD entry), so the Effect cell may look unchanged in Chrome.
properties.notes: Last original E_text leftover outside next-72. css-text-4.

properties.description: With `baseline-source: first` this box should contribute its first-line baseline to the parent.

With `inline-sizing: stretch` the inline box should stretch on the block axis inside the line. Chrome does not support this property (no MDN BCD entry), so the Effect cell may look unchanged in Chrome.
With `-webkit-text-stroke: 1px #000` glyph outlines should draw a 1px black stroke.
properties.notes: Compat shorthand, not an alias of SVG stroke. New paint. Phase 82 slice E.

properties.description: With `-webkit-text-stroke-color: #c00` the text stroke should be red.
With `-webkit-text-stroke-width: 1px` glyph outlines should stroke 1px.
With `stroke-dasharray: 8 4` on an inline SVG path, the baked stroke-dasharray should paint a dashed stroke.
properties.notes: StrokeDashArray already stored. Missing writeSVGPresentationAttrs bake. Do not flip Implemented on store-only.

properties.description: With `stroke-dashoffset: 4` the dash pattern should start 4 user units later than offset 0.
With `stroke-linecap: round` open path ends should be round caps after bake.

properties.syntax: [ crop | arcs | miter ] || [ bevel | round | fallback ]
properties.description: With `stroke-linejoin: bevel` sharp corners should bevel. Implement miter|round|bevel only.
properties.notes: StrokeLineJoin stored. fill-stroke-3 arcs/crop is not Chrome.

properties.description: With `stroke-miterlimit: 2` and linejoin miter, sharp joins should convert to bevels.
With `fill-rule: evenodd` a self-overlapping path should show the hole.
properties.notes: Listed in applySVGPresentationProps leftovers; applyLeftoversProps returns false today.

properties.description: With `paint-order: stroke fill` the stroke should sit under the fill on a fat-stroked shape.
With `stop-color: #e67e22` on a gradient stop, the fill should pick up that stop color.
With `stop-opacity: 0.3` that gradient stop should fade.
With `text-anchor: middle` SVG text should center on x.
properties.notes: Listed in leftovers catch-all; apply currently returns false.

properties.description: With `shape-rendering: crispEdges` axis-aligned edges should snap. Stay Partial if canvas ignores the hint.
properties.notes: Hint-only. Honest Partial if raster no-ops.

properties.description: With `color-interpolation: linearRGB` gradient blends should use linear light. Stay Partial if canvas ignores the hint.
properties.notes: Hint-only. Honest Partial if raster no-ops.

properties.description: With `cx: 60` on a circle the center x should move.
properties.notes: SVG2 geometry CSS. Bake over XML attribute.

properties.description: With `cy: 40` on a circle the center y should move.
With `r: 25` the circle radius should grow.
With `rx: 20` on a rect or ellipse the x radius should change.
With `ry: 10` the y radius should change.
With `x: 16` on a rect or text the origin x should move.
With `y: 20` the origin y should move.
With CSS `d: path("M10,50 L90,50")` on a path, the baked d attribute should replace the XML path.
properties.notes: SVG2 path d as CSS. Chrome since 52.

properties.description: With `marker: url(#arr)` arrowheads should appear at all vertices.
properties.notes: Shorthand for marker-start/mid/end. Needs inline SVG defs.

properties.description: With `marker-start: url(#arr)` only the first vertex should get the marker.
With `marker-mid: url(#arr)` interior vertices should get the marker.
With `marker-end: url(#arr)` the last vertex should get the marker.
With `dominant-baseline: hanging` SVG text should hang from y.
properties.notes: Scope to SVG text bake first, not a CSS Inline rewrite. Leftover catch-all currently returns false.

properties.description: With `alignment-baseline: middle` a tspan should align to the central baseline.
With `baseline-shift: super` SVG text should shift up like superscript.
properties.notes: SVG text bake. Distinct from HTML vertical-align.

properties.description: With `image-rendering: pixelated` a scaled raster should use nearest-neighbor, not blur.
properties.notes: Highest non-SVG print value in the SVG bucket. HTML img scaler plus optional SVG bake.

properties.description: With `text-rendering: geometricPrecision` glyph placement should not snap to integer px.
properties.notes: Overlaps font-kerning/ligatures. HTML shaper flags plus SVG bake.

properties.description: With `vector-effect: non-scaling-stroke` a scaled SVG stroke should keep device-pixel width.
With `fill-color: #c0392b` inline SVG fill should match `fill: #c0392b`. Chrome does not support this property (no MDN BCD entry), so the Effect cell may look unchanged in Chrome.
properties.notes: fill-stroke-3 longhand. Map onto existing fill if syntax matches; otherwise honest Partial. Chrome uses fill, already Implemented.

properties.description: With `stroke-color: #2c3e50` inline SVG stroke should match `stroke: #2c3e50`. Chrome does not support this property (not in Chrome), so the Effect cell may look unchanged in Chrome.
properties.notes: fill-stroke-3 longhand. Map onto existing stroke if syntax matches. Chrome uses stroke.

properties.description: With `clip-path: inset(12px)` ink outside the inset box should be gone.
properties.notes: Lite: none|inset()|circle(). Reuse canonicalShapeInset/Circle. Forbidden proof: TestOverflowClip. polygon/path/url later.

properties.description: With `clip: rect(10px, 90px, 90px, 10px)` on an abspos box, paint outside that rect should be gone.
properties.notes: Obsolete but print-visible. Only position absolute/fixed.

properties.description: With `clip-rule: evenodd` a later self-crossing clip path should use even-odd fill. On inset/circle both keywords should still clip.
properties.notes: PDF today emits W n only. Need W* for evenodd.

properties.description: With `mask-image: url(logo.png)` the element should show through the image alpha, or luminance if mask-mode says so.
properties.notes: Lite: single PNG. Forbidden proof: image /SMask alone. Form group x luminance/alpha.

properties.description: With `mask-mode: alpha` the mask should use the image alpha, not luminance.
With `mask-size: cover` the mask image should cover the mask origin box.
With `mask-repeat: no-repeat` the mask should appear once, not tiled.
With `mask-position: center` the mask image should sit in the middle of the origin box.
With `mask-origin: content-box` mask placement should use the content box.
With `mask-clip: padding-box` the mask should not paint into the border area.
With `mask: url(logo.png) center / contain no-repeat` the longhands should match that layer.
With `mask-composite: add` two mask layers should combine. Other operators can stay Partial.
With `mask-type: alpha` on a mask source, the mask should use alpha.
properties.notes: Applies to SVG mask elements. Drop to 88.8 defer if no real consumer lands.

properties.description: With `-webkit-mask: url(logo.png)` the mask shorthand should match unprefixed mask.
properties.notes: Flip only after mask is Implemented. normalizeVendorPrefix.

properties.description: With `-webkit-mask-image: url(logo.png)` the mask image should match unprefixed mask-image.
With `-webkit-mask-size: cover` the mask size should match unprefixed mask-size.
With `-webkit-mask-repeat: no-repeat` the mask repeat should match unprefixed mask-repeat.
With `-webkit-mask-position: center` the mask position should match unprefixed mask-position.
With `-webkit-mask-origin: content-box` the mask origin should match unprefixed mask-origin.
With `-webkit-mask-clip: padding-box` the mask clip should match unprefixed mask-clip.
With `-webkit-mask-composite: source-over` the composite should remap onto mask-composite add.
properties.notes: Value space differs (source-over vs add). Needs remapWebkitValue.

properties.description: With `zoom: 1.5` used lengths on that element should scale like operator --zoom.
properties.notes: CLI --zoom already writes load.zoomfactor and layout zoomScale. CSS zoom is still unsupported.

properties.description: With `block-ellipsis: auto` a clamped block should end the last kept line with an ellipsis. Chrome does not support this property (not in Chrome), so the Effect cell may look unchanged in Chrome.
properties.notes: line-clamp/max-lines/text-overflow already Implemented. This is the missing longhand.

properties.syntax: auto | discard | collapse | -webkit-legacy | overflow | paginate | fragments
properties.description: With `continue: discard` lines after max-lines should not paint. Chrome does not support this property (not in Chrome), so the Effect cell may look unchanged in Chrome.
With `row-rule: 2pt solid #c00` the three row-rule longhands should apply together.
properties.notes: Shorthand of width/style/color. Clone column-rule. Paint in flex/grid gaps.

properties.description: With `row-rule-width: 2pt` a rule should sit in the row gap.
properties.notes: Clone applyColumnRuleProps / emitColumnRules for row gaps.

properties.description: With `row-rule-style: solid` the row gap rule should paint.
With `row-rule-color: #c00` the row gap rule should be red.
With `rule: 1pt solid #666` column and row gap rules should match.
With `rule-width: 2pt` both column and row rules should thicken.
With `rule-style: dashed` both gap rules should be dashed.
With `rule-color: #333` both gap rules should use that color.

With `line-padding: 0.5em` wrapped CJK lines should keep extra inline inset at the wrap edge. Chrome does not support this property (no MDN BCD entry), so the Effect cell may look unchanged in Chrome.
properties.notes: css-text-4. New field on line start/end.

properties.description: With `line-fit-edge: cap alphabetic` the line box should fit those text edges, not the leading. Chrome does not support this property (no MDN BCD entry), so the Effect cell may look unchanged in Chrome.
properties.notes: text-edge already parsed for text-box. Reuse that parser.

properties.description: With `ruby-position: under` rt should sit below the ruby base, not inline after it.
properties.notes: Subset over|under. Need UA display for ruby/rt/rp. Leftover catch-all currently returns false. Do not claim Implemented until a ruby box exists.

properties.description: With `ruby-align: center` annotation and base should center against each other.
properties.notes: Same ruby layout batch as ruby-position.

properties.description: With `min-intrinsic-sizing: zero-if-scrollbars` min-content should ignore scrollbar gutters. Chrome does not support this property (no MDN BCD entry), so the Effect cell may look unchanged in Chrome.
properties.notes: css-sizing-4. Print PDFs rarely show scrollbars; still a real used-size knob.

properties.description: With `column-rule-break: none` a column rule should not paint through a break in the rule.
properties.notes: css-gaps-1 companion to existing column-rule paint. Do not take the inset-cap/junction pile.

properties.description: With `ruby-overhang: auto` short ruby may hang over adjacent characters. gowk leaves this Unsupported this wave; the Effect cell is an honesty panel, not a live demo.
properties.notes: Honest defer until ruby-position/align paint. Needs neighboring glyph metrics.

properties.description: With `ruby-merge: merge` adjacent annotations should combine. Chrome does not support this property (no MDN BCD entry), so the Effect cell may look unchanged in Chrome. gowk leaves this Unsupported this wave; the Effect cell is an honesty panel, not a live demo.
properties.notes: Honest defer. Experimental. Same pattern as Borders-4 until a ruby box exists.
